scope: Executed frozen-input prescribed-history LRS Bianchi I test-field benchmark in the existing Python Thomson backend; finite numerical observations only

derived: LRS null characteristic and meridional screen
numerically_checked: paired one-axis refinements on guarded domain
exact collisionless and independent collision comparisons
unresolved_or_out_of_scope: No proof of continuum convergence, rigorous enclosure, statistical confidence interval, or total physical error bound.
No renewed admission of the producer history continuum accuracy or source/closure uncertainty.
No observer tail, observed-redshift mapping, total CMB optical depth, temperature multipole or observed CMB C_l prediction.
No coupled ionizing spectrum, gas thermal feedback, RCT photon spectrum, or radiation backreaction.
No claim that the small history response is robust against uncomputed thermal/source/closure model changes.
No production integration or merge in rei_bianchi or bass is inferred from this dossier.

acceptance.metric: sum of absolute paired refinement changes plus empirical four-null floor; NOT a rigorous bound or statistical uncertainty

git_integration_scope: Additive BASS_HE research dossier; no production integration or merge in BASS_HE, bass or rei_bianchi.
stop_rule: Close this scoped benchmark; do not run further unchanged-scope refinement or replay completed campaigns for this decision.
prior_owner_assessment: analysis/B1_NUMERICAL_ASSESSMENT.json preserves its pre-decision proposal status; this file and review/DECISION.json provide the closed decision.
